correctness.rationale: For any compact invariant probability measure supported in z>0, all needed smooth observables are legitimate. Exact Lie derivatives L(y²/2)=xy, L(xy)=x²+y²(z−1)−δxy, Lz=η(h−z−y²z), Llogz=η(h/z−1−y²). Their zero stationary integrals eliminate xy and y²z to give E[x²]=E[z]+h E[1/z]−(h+1) and E[y²]=hE[1/z]−1. The exact centered-reciprocal identity yields the nonnegative defect decomposition. If E[x²]=0, continuity and support imply x=0 throughout the invariant support; then y constant, y(z−1)=0. For y≠0, z=1 forces h=1+y², equilibrium; for y=0 the scalar pressure z′=η(h−z) has only equilibrium invariant compact probability z=h. Conversely equilibria have x=0. For non-equilibrium ergodic measures activity strictly positive. Independent symbolic differentiation was performed; no numerical trajectory is claimed as proof.
